current_example.problem: Let ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157278/assets/62c2745fbac8e2f9774b96e15c23128ec84b0519f9d76e00c20dcea82d06fdff.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157278/assets/baeebf8292d954a34b7ba8991f5b7f5f4280f53de2c1c23d63ed1a062dbb63df.svg). Find the vector projection of $\mathbf{a}$ onto $\mathbf{b}$.
current_example.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{a\cdot b}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 1+0\cdot 5+1\cdot (-1)}{{1}^{2}+{5}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{0}{{1}^{2}+{5}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}b \\  & =⟨0,0,0⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
